summary: WorkAdmissionPort::submit: the admission transaction ported from WorkStore.submit - advisory lock, idempotent replay via the first-event receipt, the pending cap, the workflow base fence, the task insert, the queued event, and the notify. Delivery admission and external-profile enqueue are host concerns outside the port (the request type carries no fields for them).
signature: pub(crate) fn submit(store: &crate::work_store::PgWorkStore, request: &forge_work::SubmitRequest) -> Result<forge_work::ControlOutcome, forge_work::WorkError>;
responsibilities: title = work_common::prepare_title(&request.prompt) (propagates its 400). intent = work_common::intent_digest of the object {project_alias, base_revision, mode, agent_profile, prompt, acceptance_criteria} plus auto_repair:true only when request.auto_repair, plus workflow_policy_digest only when present (the exact Python _submit_intent_digest field set; workflow_policy_id does not exist in the Rust request).

Open session.in_tx. advisory_lock(owner, project). Run task_receipt_by_idempotency (pinned): when a row exists, compare intent_digest: equal -> replay (below); not equal -> also accept the variant digest computed WITHOUT the workflow fields when the stored digest equals it (the digest/id fence-switch tolerance), else rejected(409, idempotency_conflict). Replay: the receipt_json is the stored receipt object; return work_rows::outcome_for(tx, owner, project, receipt.task_id, 1, true).

Pending cap: SELECT count(*) AS pending FROM forge_agent.coding_tasks WHERE owner_id=$1 AND project_alias=$2 AND status IN ('queued','running','cancel_requested'); pending >= store.max_pending -> rejected(503, queue_full).

Workflow: when request.workflow_policy_digest is Some, run merge_head (pinned); when it yields a head different from request.base_revision -> rejected(409, result_mismatch). auto_repair is forced true when a workflow is present (effective_auto_repair).

Recipe document: work_rows::pinned_recipe_for(tx, owner, project, &request.recipe_digest); None -> rejected(503, unavailable) (the digest has never been pinned; recipe documents are catalog data the request deliberately does not carry).
Insert the task with the pinned INSERT (status queued, revision 1, review_required = (mode == "implement"), title, pinned_recipe document, intent). task_id = a fresh uuid::Uuid::new_v4().
ensure_review_policy(tx, store, project, task_id) via work_control.

When a workflow is present: INSERT INTO forge_agent.coding_workflows(owner_id,project_alias,root_task_id,policy_digest,snapshot) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5) RETURNING workflow_id with the request's workflow_snapshot (or {"policy_digest": digest} when the snapshot is None); then UPDATE forge_agent.coding_tasks SET workflow_required=true, workflow_id=$1 WHERE owner_id=$2 AND project_alias=$3 AND id=$4. Identity recording (coding_task_identities) runs only when the identity catalog is ready: register the recipe identity (subject "{agent_profile}:{mode}", document = the pinned recipe document, legacy digest = recipe_digest) and, for workflows, the workflow_policy identity (subject "policy", document = snapshot minus policy_digest, legacy = policy_digest), then INSERT INTO forge_agent.coding_task_identities(owner_id,project_alias,task_id,recipe_id,workflow_id,workflow_policy_id) VALUES($1..$6) with workflow_id/workflow_policy_id null when absent. Registration: SELECT identity_id, generation FROM forge_agent.coding_identity_register($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6).

Build the receipt object {task_id, project_alias, revision: 1, status: "queued", recipe_digest, actor: actor_json(request.actor)} and insert_event(kind queued, payload = receipt, actor, first = true). notify. Return outcome_for(tx, ..., 1, false).
invariants: One coding_tasks row, one sequence-1 queued event, and the notify commit in ONE transaction; a replay inserts nothing.
The receipt object is the sequence-1 event payload, exactly as Python stores it.
